lines: # Reference program for the compiler's output-equivalence test.
# The compiled artifact of this program is checked in next to it. A compiler change that
# alters the artifact fails the test, so an intended change to the generated code is made
# visible by regenerating the artifact, and an unintended one is caught.
# Every feature of the compiler appears here at least once: module wiring in both
# directions, sourced constants, register aliases for data and location registers,
# constants, macros, both repeat forms and the caret shorthand, origin and direction
# changes, every placement form, procedures with all four parameter kinds including a
# procedure-local alias, calls across modules and through a passed-on import, a call and a
# return guarded by a conditional, a jump to a label of another module, and control blocks.
.IMPORT "lib/nav.evo" AS NAV USING UTIL AS ARITH
# Placement forms: a range, several single cells, a stepped range, a wildcard and a
# The imported modules were placed from 0|0 along the first axis; own code starts below.
CALL UTIL.CLAMP REF %VALUE VAL DATA:0 MAX_VALUE
CALL NAV.PATROL REF %COUNT LREF %POS LVAL MARK
# Downward code below every placement: the rows above are taken by the placements, and a
# cell cannot hold an instruction and a placed molecule at once.
# The relative forms: a row started from the write cursor, and a direction turned by 90 degrees
# Control blocks on a row of their own below every other cell: a loop with a block nested in
# its case, and the entry into a block another module exports, at its start and at a case.
JMPI END                              # then the loop ends
.CONTROL CHECK                          # nested: leaves the outer loop
JMPI COUNTDOWN.END                  # then the outer loop ends
JMPI COUNTDOWN; NOP^4; JMPI COUNTDOWN   # repeat
# Standalone module without dependencies. Exports a label and a procedure.
EXPORT .PROC CLAMP REF VALUE VAL MIN MAX
# Shared constants, loaded with .SOURCE. A sourced file may not import or require.
# Module that hands a required dependency down to its own import and passes that import
# back up with EXPORT, so the root reaches it as NAV.STEP, and that exports a control block.
EXPORT .IMPORT "lib/step.evo" AS STEP USING ARITH AS CALC
EXPORT .PROC PATROL REF X LREF L LVAL M
# A loop on a row of its own, entered by an importer at its start or, through the exported
# case, where the walk is blocked.
EXPORT .CONTROL SCOUT                     # while the cell ahead is passable
JMPI BLOCKED                          # then the walk is blocked
JMPI SCOUT; NOP^4; JMPI SCOUT           # repeat
# Module that declares its dependency with .REQUIRE and leaves the choice to its importer.
CALL CALC.CLAMP REF X VAL DATA:0 MAX_VALUE
# Shared constants, loaded with .SOURCE. A sourced file may not import or require.
